title: Seagrove Sparrow
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘‘Seagrove Sparrow” a Luxury 6 Bedroom, 6.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 18 guests, this home offers a private pool, Gulf & Lake Views, bikes & 6-seater golf cart included.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 6 Bedrooms • 6.5 Bathrooms • Sleeps 18 • 2nd Floor Private Pool - (Pool can be heated for an additional $40 per day from October 1st – May 1st) • Gulf Views & Coastal Dune Lake Views • 3 Stories & 4,753 Square Feet • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Beach Access within Walking Distance • Access to Eastern Lake • Parking for 6 Vehicles Welcome to 'Seagrove Sparrow,' a remarkable luxury beach home that perfectly blends modern sophistication with the serene beauty of Seagrove Beach. This exquisite property boasts breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico and the rare coastal dune lake, Eastern Lake. Positioned along the coveted San Roy Road, this home places you just steps away from sugar-white sands, emerald waters, and the best that 30A has to offer. Marvel at the expansive vistas of the Gulf and Eastern Lake from multiple vantage points throughout the home. A one-of-a-kind feature, the private second-floor pool offers a serene oasis with unmatched views, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The main living area includes two distinct seating areas, providing ample space for gatherings or quiet moments of reflection. Culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the upscale appliances and thoughtful design of the chef's kitchen, making meal preparation a delight. Younger guests will love the playful and inviting bunk room, offering both comfort and charm. Entertainment options abound, from a friendly match on the ping pong table to setting the perfect ambiance with the premium Sonos sound system. Explore 30A with ease using the golf cart and six adult bikes included with the property, and enjoy quick and easy access to the beach located just down the street. This better-than-new luxury estate spans six bedrooms, six full bathrooms, and one half bathroom, providing ample space for family and guests. The thoughtfully designed layout offers multiple living spaces, ensuring both privacy and togetherness. A private garage, ample additional parking, and an unparalleled outdoor living space make this property a standout along 30A. Seagrove Beach offers an array of fun activities and attractions to enrich your stay. Discover the charm of nearby boutique shops, savor delicious meals at local restaurants, or embark on outdoor adventures such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and biking along the scenic trails. Take a stroll through the nearby state parks or enjoy world-class fishing in the emerald waters. Ideally located within the heart of Seagrove Beach, 'Seagrove Sparrow' offers not just a place to stay but an experience to cherish. World-class fishing, first-rate dining, luxury shopping, and the natural beauty of 30A are all within reach, making this home the ultimate destination for your next coastal retreat.
